snapshot.title: 原皮
snapshot.text: A character turnaround sheet showing a front half-body view, a side full-body view, and a back full-body view on a white background. The character is Chinatsu, with medium-length silver-gray softly wavy hair, a mint-green bow hair clip and black butterfly-and-cross hair clip on the right side, and light-colored eyes. Outfit: a cute-cool Decora idol style, consisting of a white short-sleeved shirt, a red tie with a heart motif, a black choker, a pair of small white angel wings, and a pink angel-wing backpack on the back; pink-and-white striped fingerless arm warmers extending above the elbows; a black multilayered tutu skirt with a wide white belt; a pink thigh strap and small shoulder bag on the left thigh; white distressed over-the-knee socks; pink-and-white striped leg warmers; pink-and-white platform shoes; and black ankle straps with mint-green bows. Palette: silver gray, white, black, pink, and mint green. Use as a character identity and clothing reference.
